No Wait Valley[/size][/b]

Accelerate time in Stardew Valley with a single keypress. Fast-forward while machines process, waiting for events, or during bedtime. Configure speeds and auto-stop times to your preference.

[b][color=#ffff00]- Multiplayer: This mod now works in multiplayer!
[/color][/b]

[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]

- Toggle time acceleration with a configurable keybind (default: Z)
- Configurable acceleration multiplier (default: 200%)
- Automatic deactivation at a configurable time (default: 1:00 AM / 2500 in-game time)
- Bed-time acceleration - skip through the night when sleeping
- Compatible with Automate and other mods

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

You can configure the mod options:

1. In-game using Generic Mod Config Menu (if installed)
2. By editing the `config.json` file in the mod folder

Options include:
- Toggle key (default: Z)
- Speedup multiplier in percent (default: 200%, range: 200-300%)
- Auto-stop time (default: 2500, which is 1:00 AM in Stardew Valley time format)
  - Note: Stardew Valley uses 24-hour time that continues past midnight (2400 = midnight, 2500 = 1:00 AM, 2600 = 2:00 AM)
- Bed-time acceleration toggle (default: enabled)
- Bed-time acceleration multiplier (default: 300%, range: 200-500%)

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

- Stardew Valley 1.6+
- SMAPI 4.0.0+

[size=4][b]Optional Dependencies[/b][/size]

- Generic Mod Config Menu (for in-game settings)

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

This mod should be compatible with Automate and most other mods.
    - Note: I'd recommend lowering the Automation Interval with higher speeds.

[size=4][b]Multiplayer Support
[/b][/size]

[b]In multiplayer mode:[/b]
- Only the host (main player) can control time acceleration
- When the host toggles acceleration, all players see visual feedback
- Bed-time acceleration also only works for the host
- All players should install the mod to see the same notifications and feedback
- Time changes are synchronized across all players

[b]Important Multiplayer Sleep Note:[/b]
While the host can accelerate time until 2:00 AM when going to bed, remember that in multiplayer all players must sleep for the day to end.
The mod will accelerate time, but the new day won't start until all farmhands are also in bed.
For best results, coordinate with other players to ensure everyone goes to bed around the same time.

[size=4]Language Support[/size]

No Wait Valley is available in the following languages:
- English (default)
- Spanish
- French
- German
- Italian
- Portuguese (Portugal)
- Portuguese (Brazil)
- Polish
- Danish
- Turkish
- Korean
- Japanese
- Chinese
